name: Page

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story residence with a gray multi-gable roof covered by extensive solar panels|A paved driveway leads to the front of the house|Landscaped lawn, trees, and plantings surround the structure|Detached structures including a greenhouse or shed are visible in the rear yard|The property is located in a residential neighborhood.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the home|Open lawn, a greenhouse or covered structure, and additional outdoor features are present|Trees and fencing enclose portions of the rear yard|A vehicle is visible near the side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to the front of the residence. The front of the property is open and clearly accessible. Fencing encloses portions of the side and rear yard. Open driveway and front yard areas provide space for emergency vehicle staging. The rear yard contains open lawn and outdoor structures. Neighboring homes are close in this residential setting.
